description: Type templates.get's HTTP 400 'Template ... is not visible to the current project.' Integrations answers a nonexistent template id with this 400 instead of 404, so a template deleted out-of-band surfaced as a generic BadRequest during read.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The template does not exist in (or is not shared with) the current project (HTTP 400). Integrations returns this instead of 404 for a missing template id.

message.includes: is not visible to the current project
